_comment: Reviewed, committed pins for the ONE-TIME Base Mainnet MPGRExecutor deployment. script/DeployMPGRExecutorBaseMainnet.s.sol aborts unless the base-mainnet environment variables MPGR_EXECUTOR_OWNER / MPGR_EXECUTOR_FEE_RECIPIENT equal these values, MPGR_MAINNET_DEPLOY_ENABLED is 'true', mainnetDeployEnabled is true here, and deployments/base-mainnet/mpgr-executor.json does not exist yet. Set mainnetDeployEnabled to false after the deployment. Deploying does NOT enable app routing: lib/executor/executor-config.ts keeps chain 8453 null.
